|}</includeonly><noinclude>
<br clear="all">
==Usage==
To create a set of tabs, use these four elements. Keep the page tabs in the same order on all pages, use "Tab1" for the current page, and use "Tab2" for all others.

{{tl|TabsTop}}<br/>
{{tlx|Tab1|Current page name}}<br/>
{{tlx|Tab2|Other page name(s)}}<br/>
{{tl|TabsBottom}}

==Example==
Using optional variable bordercolor (magenta, the tab-free line extending to the right):
<code><nowiki>{{TabsBottom|bordercolor=#d9138a}}</nowiki></code>

Produces:
{{TabsTop}}
{{Tab2|[[Template:TabsTop|TabsTop]]}}
{{Tab2|[[Template:Tab1|Tab1]]}}
{{Tab2|[[Template:Tab2|Tab2]]}}
{{Tab1|TabsBottom}}
{{TabsBottom|bordercolor=#d9138a}}

[[Category:Utility templates|{{PAGENAME}}]]</noinclude>
